H5329: properly, to glitter from afar, i.e. to be eminent (as a superintendent, especially of the Temple services and its music); to be permanent
H5921: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
H5058: properly, instrumental music; by implication, a stringed instrument; by extension, a poem set to music; specifically, an epigram
H1732: David, the youngest son of Jesse
H8085: to hear intelligently (often with implication of attention, obedience, etc.; causatively, to tell, etc.)
H430: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
H7440: properly, a creaking (or shrill sound), i.e. shout (of joy or grief)
H7181: to prick up the ears, i.e. hearken
H8605: intercession, supplication; by implication, a hymn
H776: the earth (at large, or partitively a land)
H413: near, with or among; often in general, to
H7121: to call out to (i.e. properly, address by name, but used in a wide variety of applications)
H5848: to shroud, i.e. clothe (whether transitive or reflex.); hence (from the idea of darkness) to languish
H3820: the heart; also used (figuratively) very widely for the feelings, the will and even the intellect; likewise for the centre of anything
H6697: properly, a cliff (or sharp rock, as compressed); generally, a rock or boulder; figuratively, a refuge; also an edge (as precipitous)
H7311: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
H4480: properly, a part of; hence (prepositionally), from or out of in many senses
H5148: to guide; by implication, to transport (into exile, or as colonists)
H3588: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
H1961: to exist, i.e. be or become, come to pass (always emphatic, and not a mere copula or auxiliary)
H4026: a tower (from its size or height); by analogy, a rostrum; figuratively, a (pyramidal) bed of flowers
H5797: strength in various applications (force, security, majesty, praise)
H6440: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
H1481: properly, to turn aside from the road (for a lodging or any other purpose), i.e. sojourn (as a guest); also to shrink, fear (as in a strange place); also to gather forhostility (as afraid)
H168: a tent (as clearly conspicuous from a distance)
H5769: properly, concealed, i.e. the vanishing point; generally, time out of mind (past or future), i.e. (practically) eternity; frequentatively, adverbial (especially with prepositional prefix) always
H2620: to flee for protection; figuratively, to confide in
H5643: a cover (in a good or a bad, a literal or a figurative sense)
H3671: an edge or extremity; specifically (of a bird or army) a wing, (of a garment or bedclothing) a flap, (of the earth) a quarter, (of a building) a pinnacle
H859: thou and thee, or (plural) ye and you
H5088: a promise (to God); also (concretely) a thing promised
H5414: to give, used with greatest latitude of application (put, make, etc.)
H3425: something occupied; a conquest; also a patrimony
H8034: an appellation, as amark or memorial of individuality; by implication honor, authority, character
H3117: a day (as the warm hours), whether literal (from sunrise to sunset, or from one sunset to the next), or figurative (a space of time defined by an associated term), (often used adverb)
H3254: to add or augment (often adverbial, to continue to do a thing)
H8141: a year (as a revolution of time)
H3644: a form of the prefix 'k-', but used separately as, thus, so
H1755: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling
H3427: properly, to sit down (specifically as judge. in ambush, in quiet); by implication, to dwell, to remain; causatively, to settle, to marry
H2617: kindness; by implication (towards God) piety; rarely (by opposition) reproof, or (subject.) beauty
H4487: properly, to weigh out; by implication, to allot or constitute officially; also to enumerate or enroll
H5341: to guard, in a good sense (to protect, maintain, obey, etc.) or a bad one (to conceal, etc.)
H3651: properly, set upright; hence (figuratively as adjective) just; but usually (as adverb or conjunction) rightly or so (in various applications to manner, time and relation; often with other particles)
H2167: play upon it; to make music, accompanied by the voice; hence to celebrate in song and music
H5703: properly, a (peremptory) terminus, i.e. (by implication) duration, in the sense of advance or perpetuity (substantially as a noun, either with or without a preposition)
H7999: to be safe (in mind, body or estate); figuratively, to be (causatively, make) completed; by implication, to be friendly; by extension, to reciprocate (in various applications)
